svg.title: Keeper of the Voyage Log / EPIC

g.data-name: EPIC / amethyst and gold, interlaced corner knots, gem rails
Rarity / amethyst and gold, interlaced corner knots, gem rails
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: The keeper of the voyage log joins scattered observations
into an account others can examine. Disciplined memory
carries the expedition beyond its own lifetime, preserving
the difficult boundary between witnessed fact and wonder.
